label: Altitude
value: Gabral town is about 2,290 m; the valley runs north for about 38 km

label: The valley
value: About 387 km² on the south slopes of the westernmost Himalayas
quote: The valley covers about 38,733 hectares (387.33 km2).

label: From Kalam
value: Gabral is about 20 km north of Kalam by road
quote: about 20 km north (by road) from Kalam

label: The road
value: A road runs beside the river for about 14 km, up the valley from Gabral
quote: A road runs parallel to the river for about 14 km, until 2 km below Lake Kharkhari.

label: Kharkhari Lake
value: About 41 km by road from Kalam, at 5,160 m
quote: It is located about 41 km by road from the town of Kalam

label: Utror
value: Utror is 16 km from Kalam, on the way to Gabral
quote: 16 km from Kalam Valley and 120 km from Saidu Sharif

label: Best months
value: Snow closes the upper road from December to March; October–November is autumn
quote: December–March are the winter months; the road beyond Bahrain is snowbound during this time.

label: Walks from Utror
value: Tourists hike from Utror forest toward the Izmis base camp
quote: Tourists can hike from Utror forest to the Izmis base camp
